title: Travel agency CRM — US, UK and India advertising drafts
status: DRAFT — not uploaded, scheduled or launched
evidence: The walkthrough is a silent, captioned recording of the public fictional sample CRM. No customer case study, endorsement, live booking or payment is claimed.
launchChecklist: Confirm the advertising account and its currency; choose a budget per market.
Review destinations, keyword suggestions, negative keywords and location presence settings. No search-volume or ROI claim is supplied.
Check the account-specific ad policies, assets and tracking setup before upload.
Use consent-aware attribution and validate saved enquiry, qualified lead and Won definitions before bidding on conversions.
Publish only the meeting times the team can reliably cover; confirm response and support windows.
Review real lead quality, demo attendance and proposals by campaign and business country before increasing spend.
